decision: There is no eligible unseen BTC directional-trend partition. The January-July 2026 file remains sealed and unread but is ineligible because it starts without the frozen 336-hour horizon embargo and contains less than the program's later twelve-month minimum.

No S1 inspection is recorded. The file remains sealed, but immediate adjacency to development violates the 336-hour embargo and seven months cannot satisfy the later twelve-month routing minimum.

prospective_requirement.analysis_policy: One-time analysis requires an explicit unlock revision after frozen duration and event gates pass.
prospective_requirement.earliest_start_rule: At least 336 hours after the final consumed family observation and only after the complete experiment, code, costs, and collection contract are frozen.
